title: Error Taxonomy v1
description: Stable error codes for cross-workstream APIs.

QR_PAYLOAD_TOO_LONG.message: Payload exceeds maximum length for the selected QR version and error correction level.

QR_PAYLOAD_INVALID.message: Payload contains invalid characters or an unsupported scheme.

QR_UNSUPPORTED_MODE.message: The payload requires a QR encoding mode not supported by this version.

QR_MATRIX_GENERATION_FAILED.message: QR matrix generation failed due to an internal error.

QR_RENDER_FAILED.message: QR rendering to the requested format failed.

ARTISTIC_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT.message: Artistic provider did not return a candidate within the allowed time.

ARTISTIC_PROVIDER_FAILURE.message: Artistic provider returned an error or incomplete response.

ARTISTIC_MODERATION_BLOCKED.message: Content safety check blocked the artistic generation request.

ARTISTIC_UNSCANNABLE.message: Candidate did not pass the minimum scan-validation threshold.

ARTISTIC_REPAIR_EXHAUSTED.message: Closed-loop repair reached the maximum number of cycles without success.

ARTISTIC_EXPORT_NOT_ALLOWED.message: Export is not allowed until scan_verdict is 'pass'.

ARTISTIC_SAFE_FALLBACK_USED.message: A safe deterministic fallback was used because the artistic candidate failed validation.

VALIDATION_SUITE_ERROR.message: The validation test suite encountered an internal error.

VALIDATION_DECODER_UNAVAILABLE.message: A requested decoder is not available in the current environment.

ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED.message: No remaining generation allowance for this project.

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT.message: The provided idempotency key is already in use with different parameters.

NOT_IMPLEMENTED.message: This feature is not yet implemented.
